in_marathi.name: Kashmiri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashmiri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the region of Kashmir, which means 'desirable land' or 'place of delight'. In Hindu mythology, Kashmir is known as the 'Paradise on Earth'.
